response.rationale: Elevated IgG4, pituitary stalk/body swelling, and systemic findings (sphenoid sinus thickening, lung nodule) strongly favor IgG4-related hypophysitis. Lymphocytic hypophysitis is less specific and does not account for the elevated IgG4 and systemic involvement.

rejected.why: Sinus and lung findings are nonspecific; lacks the IgG4 elevation and pituitary stalk involvement characteristic of the case.
Sellar mass is small and poorly enhancing; the clinical and laboratory profile is inflammatory rather than neoplastic, and elevated IgG4 argues against lymphoma.
